# Munger Agency

> Independent life insurance and legacy planning agency based in Dallas, TX, serving families, individuals, and businesses nationwide with 30+ A-rated carriers and 20+ years of experience.

Munger Agency, founded and led by Kathleen Munger Fisk, helps families and individuals protect their life and legacy through life insurance and financial planning. The agency works with 30+ A-rated carriers and is not tied to a single insurance company, so recommendations are built around each client's needs and budget.

## Services

- Whole, universal, and term life insurance
- Mortgage protection insurance
- Disability, critical illness, and living benefits
- Retirement annuities
- Debt Free Life / Infinite Banking planning
- Trust & will services
- Final expense insurance
- Property & casualty insurance (home, auto, business)
- Key person insurance for businesses
- Pet insurance
- LegalShield legal protection plans
